note: Watson quotes the King James Version on almost every page. Quotations where Watson argues from a KJV word Segond lacks (e.g. “peculiar”, “grave”, “sincerity”, “debts”, “high calling”) are rendered from his English.

Citations are converted from Watson’s roman numerals to French book names and arabic numerals, and follow Segond’s versification where it differs from the KJV (Psalms, plus Ésaïe 9:5, 1 Samuel 24:17, 2 Chroniques 14:10, Ecclésiaste 5:12, 1 Pierre 2:7, Osée 2:17).
